en.title: Silver Afterglow, Eternal Severance
en.premise: Genji, a ronin bearing the memories of tens of thousands of dead in his right hand, continues his journey alongside Shino. Their path leads them to a sleepless city where the echoes of festival music never fade. Awaiting them there is the final ritual to complete the 'Immortal Sword' left by Genji's former lord—and a swarm of assassins determined to claim Genji as their vessel.

zh.title: 白银的残照，不灭的断绝
zh.premise: 浪人弦次的右手承载着数万死者的记忆，他与志乃一同继续旅途。两人抵达了一座祭典乐曲不绝于耳的不夜城。在那里，等待着他们的是完成前主君遗留之“不灭之剑”的最终仪式，以及将弦次视为“容器”而穷追不舍的刺客们。
